task_description:
# Player Name Labels

Allow assigning player names to positions. Names can appear as labels above players or in a legend panel. Names are saved with playbooks.

## Rationale
Jersey numbers identify generic positions, but coaches often want to show specific player names for actual team lineups. Essential for game-specific preparation.

## User Stories
- As a coach, I want to assign actual player names so that instructions are specific
- As a player, I want to see my name on the board during team meetings

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Can assign name to any player position
- [ ] Names display as optional labels
- [ ] Can toggle name visibility on/off
- [ ] Names saved with playbook data
- [ ] Quick roster import from text list

patterns.state_management: Zustand store pattern: create<State>((set, get) => ({ state, actions }))
patterns.player_rendering: Three.js group components with meshRef, player number label at position [0, 1.5, 0.35]
patterns.ui_components: Tailwind CSS with absolute positioning, conditional rendering for dialogs
patterns.persistence: Dexie v1 with playbook schema storing playerPositions: Player[]
patterns.drei_usage: Import Text from @react-three/drei for 3D text labels
